user_clarification: The final application may replace the proprietary NUX application entirely; retaining NUX effects is optional. Target an extensible firmware under our control that runs NAM on the plug.
application: Our source plus appropriately licensed dependencies, with board drivers, NAM A2 Lite, model storage, an editable effects chain and a future phone control protocol.
factory_bootloader: Factory loader retained in tested hybrid builds. Recovery of one non-starting probe to stock was demonstrated with PRESET + RESET; arbitrary damage and complete loader protection are not established.
stock_based_candidate_role: Optional intermediate benchmark and reference for hardware behavior, not a required final architecture.
benefit: Removes the long-term need to fit new features into retired stock AMP code and RAM. Available memory, CPU deadlines and loader layout still constrain a standalone application.
cost: Requires completing startup, clocks, memory/cache, codec, audio transport and controls before independent operation. Does not itself provide an upload or recovery route.

existing_components.state: A2 Lite verified in the silent stock-driver NAMA2I01 guitar-input trial; independent firmware integration pending
Owned codec bus logic, DMA descriptor builder, Q31 adapter, startup-memory logic and compile-only reset entry; hardware backend incomplete
